exports.name: AppWindow
exports.summary:
Represents a window with the current application how it is stored
in the localstorage. It has an id, name, heartbeat represented in a timestamp
and an array of messages that that window sent out.

It's named "AppWindow" to avoid confusion with the type Window
of the global variable "window".
exports.summaryZh: 接口 `AppWindow`，定义App窗口的数据结构契约与属性规范。

properties.description: String to be used as prefix when storing data in the localstorage
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `keyPrefix`（类型：`string`），用于存储或配置键前缀。

properties.name: heartbeat
properties.description:
Time in milliseconds how often a heartbeat should be performed. During a heartbeat a window
looks for new messages from other windows and processes these messages.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `heartbeat`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置heartbeat。

properties.name: newWindowScan
properties.description: Time in milliseconds how often a scan for new windows should be performed.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `newWindowScan`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置新窗口Scan。

properties.name: messageTimeout
properties.description:
Time in milliseconds after which a message delivery is considered to have failed.
If no "message_received" confirmation has arrived during the specified duration,
the message will be removed from the outbox.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `messageTimeout`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置消息延时器。

properties.name: windowTimeout
properties.description:
Time in milliseconds after which a window is considered dead.

Should be a multiple of {@link MultiWindowConfig#newWindowScan}
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `windowTimeout`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置窗口延时器。

properties.name: windowSaveStrategy
properties.description:
A strategy to be used when it comes to saving the window name.

Refer to the different enum values for detailed description about the possible values.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `windowSaveStrategy`（类型：`WindowSaveStrategy`），用于存储或配置窗口保存策略。

exports.name: WindowSaveStrategy
exports.summary: A representation of a strategy on how to save the window id in the native window.name property.
exports.summaryZh: 枚举 `WindowSaveStrategy`，定义支持的窗口保存策略常量集合。

properties.name: NONE
properties.description: Default behaviour. Window data will not be saved.
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `WindowSaveStrategy.NONE`，表示无。

properties.name: SAVE_WHEN_EMPTY
properties.description:
Only save the window data when the storage (native window.name property) is empty/undefined, meaning nothing else is
probably utilizing it
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `WindowSaveStrategy.SAVE_WHEN_EMPTY`，表示保存WHEN空。

properties.name: SAVE_FORCE
properties.description: Save the window data without checking whether the storage might be used by another script
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `WindowSaveStrategy.SAVE_FORCE`，表示保存FORCE。

properties.name: SAVE_BACKUP
properties.description:
Save window data, but backup probable existing data in the storage and restore the original data after reading the window data.
Restoring the original data might not happen "on time" for the script using it, which would require delaying it's execution.
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `WindowSaveStrategy.SAVE_BACKUP`，表示保存BACKUP。
